title: 第2593章 我朝着你的方向跑来了第2592章 我为你不顾世俗
lines: 她仔细的擦拭着他的眉眼，脸颊。
“我一直都是一个内向又文静的人。不像夏天，人如其名，活力四射，热辣滚烫，像是一个小太阳似的，温暖着身边的人。”
“其实，她那种性子，才能够跟你合拍，互补吧。你沉稳成熟，她活泼开朗。再加上，厉家和慕家，一直都有想要亲上加亲的想法。”
“所有人都是看好你和夏天的，谁曾想……你喜欢的是我。”
慕念安坐了下来，再擦着他的手。
“其实我对你也是喜欢的吧……只是我不敢承认心底深处的那份爱意，我根本想都不敢想。”
“你比我勇敢。”
“以言，我们的关系，能够走到今天这一步，一直都是你在努力，你付出了很多，才有了今天的局面。那么，现在剩下的那一点点路，让我来走，好不好？”
“我们就差一步了。你走了九十九步，我走最后的一步。”
“这样的话，我们就能在一起了。”
温热的毛巾渐渐在手上变凉。
但是慕以言的掌心，却有了温度。
慕念安和往常一样，一边碎碎念，一边照顾他。
“不知道爸妈什么时候会过来……他们这些天也操碎了心。”
“快点醒过来吧，不要再让我沉浸在难过，悲伤，无助又自责的情绪里了。”
慕念安怔怔的看着慕以言的手。
他的手掌很宽很厚实，她将手贴上去，只有他的三分之二大。
被这样的手牵着走完一生，是一件很幸福的事情吧。
就在慕念安将自己和他掌心相贴，怔怔望着发呆的时候，她清楚的看到……
慕以言的手指，微微动了动！
虽然只是很细微很不起眼的一个动作，但是慕念安敏锐的捕捉到了！
动了！他动了！
“以言！”慕念安惊喜的跳了起来，“你听到我的话了！你快点醒过来好不好！”
“朝着光，朝着我的声音的方向奔跑，不要犹豫！”
“只要你醒来……你醒来我们就在一起！我说话算话！”
“为了你，我可以不顾世俗，不顾一切，不顾任何人的指指点点，我只要你！”
慕念安一遍又一遍的说着，五指从他指缝里穿过。
十指相扣。
紧接着，慕以言的眉眼微微动了动。
他有苏醒的迹象了！
慕念安大气都不敢出，静静的望着他，用掌心的温度来给予他力量。
快点醒来吧，以言，算她求求了。
慢慢的，慕以言的眼皮缓缓掀起，睁开了眼。
慕念安看见了他黝黑深沉的眸子！
“以言！你醒了！”
她终于等到了这一刻！
只是，慕以言的眼神还有些涣散，聚集不了光，望着天花板，眼睛一眨不眨。
慕念安都不敢惊扰他：“以言……”
他没动，只是很缓慢很缓慢的眨了眨眼，喉结滚动。
他还戴着氧气罩，说不出话来。
慕念安这才后知后觉的按铃，叫来医生：“麻烦过来一趟，他醒了……他睁开眼睛了！”
医生迅速的赶到，将病床围得水泄不通！
慕念安被挤在最外面，也看不到里面的情况，只能努力的踮起脚尖，试图去看看发生了什么！
终于，医生回头：“他在说话，但……我们听不太懂。”
content_en:
She wiped his eyebrows and cheeks carefully.
"I have always been an introverted and quiet person. Unlike summer, as the name suggests, I am full of energy and hot, like a little sun, warming the people around me."
"Actually, her temperament is what makes her compatible with you and complements each other. You are calm and mature, while she is lively and cheerful. In addition, the Li family and the Mu family have always wanted to get closer."
"Everyone is optimistic about you and Xia Tian. Who would have thought... you like me."
Mu Nianan sat down and wiped his hands again.
"Actually, I also like you...but I don't dare to admit the love deep in my heart. I don't even dare to think about it."
"You are braver than me."
"Yi Yan, our relationship has been able to reach this point because of your hard work. You have sacrificed a lot to get to where we are today. So, let me walk the little road left now, okay?"
"We are only one step away. You take the ninety-nine steps, and I take the last step."
"This way, we can be together."
The warm towel gradually became cold on my hands.
But Mu Yiyan's palm felt warm.
Mu Nian'an, as usual, was taking care of him while thinking quietly.
"I don't know when my parents will come over... They are also worried these days."
"Wake up quickly, don't let me immerse myself in sadness, sadness, helplessness and self-blame anymore."
Mu Nian'an looked at Mu Yiyan's hand in confusion.
His palm was very wide and thick. When she put her hand on it, it was only two-thirds of his size.
It is a very happy thing to be held by such a hand throughout life.
Just when Mu Nian'an put her palms against his and stared blankly, she clearly saw...
Mu Yiyan's fingers moved slightly!
Although it was just a very subtle and inconspicuous movement, Mu Nianan captured it keenly!
It's moving! He moved!
"Yi Yan!" Mu Nian'an jumped up in surprise, "You heard what I said! Please wake up quickly!"
"Run toward the light, toward the direction of my voice, without hesitation!"
"As long as you wake up... we will be together when you wake up! I keep my word!"
"For you, I can ignore the world, everything, and no one's opinions. I only want you!"
Mu Nian'an said over and over again, fingers passing through his fingers.
Fingers intertwined.
Then, Mu Yiyan's eyebrows moved slightly.
He is showing signs of waking up!
Mu Nian'an didn't dare to express his anger. She looked at him quietly and used the warmth of her palms to give him strength.
Wake up quickly, Yi Yan, please beg her.
Slowly, Mu Yiyan's eyelids slowly lifted and he opened his eyes.
Mu Nianan saw his dark and deep eyes!
"Yi Yan! You're awake!"
She finally waited for this moment!
However, Mu Yiyan's eyes were still a little distracted and could not gather the light. He stared at the ceiling without blinking.
Mu Nian'an didn't dare to disturb him: "Yi Yan..."
He didn't move, but blinked very slowly, his Adam's apple rolling.
He was still wearing an oxygen mask and was speechless.
Mu Nian'an then belatedly rang the bell and called the doctor: "Please come over here, he's awake... He's opened his eyes!"
The doctor arrived quickly and the hospital bed was completely surrounded!
Mu Nian'an was squeezed on the outside and couldn't see what was going on inside. He could only stand on tiptoes trying to see what was going on!
Finally, the doctor turned back: "He is talking, but... we can't understand him very well."
title_en: Chapter 2593 I ran in your direction Chapter 2592 I ignored the world for you
